column3: Workspace lifecycle e2e: add via composed directory dialog (with its own New folder), path-editor pane walking, rename over the wire with duplicate pre-check, delete keeps folder/log/messages, flat vs tree grouping, hover card, row menus, archive round trip; asserts host registry durability plus a clean console and zero transient slot-error/alert surfaces.

Subagent catalog e2e: child/grandchild/one-shot fixtures, catalog push updates the button with no extra /api/session/projections read, opening a child does not activate it, FIFO follow-up admission, fork out of a subagent, and a migration-required legacy catalog that is never read (no projections call, bytes unchanged on disk).

Both mid-turn steering doors: QueueDock per-row Steer and composer Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, the configurable Enter/Cmd-Enter swap, and empty-draft flush of the whole queue FIFO; steering lands durably as exactly one user/message and the reply obeys a marker word; record mode rejects a vacuous fixture.

macOS window-drag geometry coverage: collects every -webkit-app-region box with five-point hit tests, asserts no interactive control is swallowed by the drag band, uses the shared isDraggableAt model, and carries a gap field for known-unmet expectations that still fail loudly.

Composer Stop interrupting a running continuable child: parent-offline variant (Send disabled, Stop enabled), the interrupt must use subagents/interruptByParent and never /api/session/cancel, the follow-up parks with the Activation resident, and only a waking send resumes it FIFO; asserts the persisted turn-end ledger.

Icon-action footer arrives only with turn/end: a hang patch on the second model call parks the turn so the running state is deterministic; asserts the user bubble owns the only footer while running, the frozen partial takes the seat when settled, the exact per-turn usage dialog figures, and per-preset whole-turn presentation.

Browser dictation e2e with a fake speech provider registered through the real plugin API: setup dialog focus trap, preparation state machine (unprepared/checking/failed/standby), device enumeration and loss, RIFF audio assertion, and the rule that only reviewed text is submitted (messages stays 0 until Enter).

Secondary-typography contract for expanded reasoning: headings not promoted but Markdown semantics preserved, code pinned to 11px/19px, short formulas need no scrollbar while long atoms and display math must scroll, 7 bounded scroll containers, sticky header keeps pointer events over a scrolling table.

Shared web-test plumbing: dist path, built-package require, free-port probe, failure screenshots, English/zh page factories, host and browser clock pinning (Date Proxy, not page.clock, with the negative-delay explanation), per-key composer typing because Lexical drops fill(), and a conversation context key restated rather than imported across the plane boundary.

Shared terminal-card assertion library: Range-based selection measurement, native selection plus clipboard sentinel verification, overflow-only tabindex/role/aria affordance that must disappear when the text fits, and the status dot aligned to the first visual line of a wrapped command.

Virtualized tail-paged Trajectory contract: semantic row identity and 2px offset stability across a held older-page prepend under a live selection, mounted rows bounded at 160, reachable scroll ranges, and at most 5 scrollTo calls during a streaming reply.

Real web_search against a deterministic local Search API double and the real credentials service: the request body and Bearer header are pinned exactly, results are capped with a model-visible truncation notice, the card shows exactly the kept sources in a 320px scroller, and marker room is measured so right-aligned numbers are never clipped.

Durable workflow Conversation Node: two-stage settlement barrier (turn/end then agent idle then session flush), disclosure rows as real buttons with Enter/Space, a measured narrow+dark layout contract, and the terminal record rebuilt from history after reload.

Web build config: manualChunks vendor set of directly-imported React-free packages so editing shell code re-hashes only index, boot vs lazy shiki grammars split by file, preview.html emission with bootstrap, and rejectStandaloneServe throwing before a dev server can expose a boot-manifest-free shell.

Browserless half of the interrupt contract over plain HTTP Remote calls: queue a follow-up, interrupt, assert parked-not-resumed state (one turn/start, aborted turn/end, follow-up retained), then a waking send resumes FIFO; asserts the exact persisted user-text order and turn-end kinds.

Client TypeScript project: extends the base config, includes src and tests, references six workspace packages, and excludes ~190 host-plane e2e files because one program cannot see both sides of the cordis Context merges; several of this shard's specs are on that excluded list.

Sidebar ordering: recency vs saved manual order, the versioned dsh.workspace.view.v5 localStorage preference (per-account order plus a flat order), drag-to-reorder persistence, reset on Last updated, and a held websocket baseline to exercise a mid-reconnect projection reload.

Streaming code-fence highlighting with a deterministic LlmAdapter that pauses twice: the mid-stream shiki token tree must equal the settled tree exactly and the block/pre/line DOM nodes are marked and proven retained (no re-creation, no highlight flicker).

Local speech-model download failures: the alert names the HTTP status, the resolved asset path and the actual source origin; retry re-issues; manual vs automatic mirror selection is a deterministic HEAD race and both origins must serve the identical asset path.

Sidebar fold quota: 5 established sessions plus the provisional New Session row, Show-N-more counts derived from the total, an explicit hover set because Chromium does not recompute :hover on re-render, and a watermark raised by the opened session that survives leaving it and resets on fold.

Whole-session stats over paged history: a generated 28-turn (56-message) seed proves the strip reports the whole log on a partial first page and that loading earlier moves no figure (counts, wall times, token groups) because the numbers come from a projection, not a window fold.

Git Worktrees as an opt-in plugin toggle asserted at four levels (UI switch, profile manifest bundles, Loader fibers, tool schemas): granting adds create_worktree, revoking removes the capability but keeps the checkout, the branch and the session working directory; git runs with an isolated config and no hooks.

Forked agent inherits the standard preset and refuses every reminder tool: the child's requestHeader must equal the parent's, the tool-schema set is pinned to schemas.initial and the system prompt to system-prompt.expected.md, four identical subagent_session refusals are asserted, and refresh mode rewrites the fixture through a six-stage scrub.

Every recorded tool row (45 of them) expands through its own keyed renderer with a list and exactly one Inspect button, no ioCard, per-call ARIA snapshots concatenated into one golden, todo_write diff summary as a separate field, and a 360px no-overflow layout check.

jsdom spec over the BUILT client graph: the Trajectory details panel renders the same blob object URL as Chat (one attachment read per session attachment), with the virtualizer scroll-idle drain explained and offsetHeight/scrollTo pinned because jsdom reports zero heights.

A credential the user typed is masked behind a reveal control; the mask is one character per original character so revealing does not move the line (bounding boxes compared before/after) and the mask and its control share one vertical centre within 1px; the key literal is assembled at run time.

First-run voice plugin guidance: enabling opens a deferral dialog whose Later keeps the switch checked and leaves no status badge, Go to setup lands on the detail page, and the source picker defaults to Automatic with exactly three options; the trust copy about local download and proxying is asserted verbatim.

jsdom spec over the built client graph pinning the todo_write row and the dock plan strip as three separate fields (title, summary, summarySuffix) plus per-status items, so folding the +N count back into the summary changes the file; golden is a normalised .txt shape, not an ARIA snapshot.

jsdom spec over the built client graph: the submission echo paints synchronously on the send keystroke with a blob preview while the composer is already cleared and editable, and the durable user/message retires it by requestId correlation with no duplicate text.

Bare Vite must fail before presenting a bootless shell: both the package dev alias and the raw vite binary must exit non-zero with the full-host correction naming dsh web and window.__DSH_BOOT__, and a listen-probe preload proves no port was ever bound.

Recorded browser timezone is isolated from the host's: newEnglishPage pins Asia/Shanghai and en-US per context while an ambient page in the same browser still reports the host zone, checked under UTC and America/Los_Angeles.
9-line Node preload that appends to a marker file on every Server.prototype.listen call, used to assert a server was never started; the marker env var disables it when unset.
